title: BodyMap record v1.0
description: One record. Three kinds: episode (something felt), visit (saw a clinician), note (anything else). All times ISO-8601 with offset. Records are append-only; a correction is a new record with supersedes set.

started_at.description: When it began. For quick capture this is the only required time.

ended_at.description: When it passed. null = still going or not recorded. Never guessed.

supersedes.description: id of an earlier record this one corrects. The earlier record is kept.

model_version.description: Body model the marks were placed on, e.g. z-anatomy-2024.1-lowpoly-v1

tests.description: Checks already done. This is the 'already ruled out' column on the doctor export.

location.description: Body coordinate. Independent of camera, device and screen. part_id comes from the model's mesh names; local is the hit position normalized inside that part's bounding box.

part_id.description: Stable id from the model, e.g. vastus_lateralis

local.description: [x,y,z] in the part's local bounding box, 0..1

view.description: Camera side the mark was placed from. Display hint only.

radius.description: Mark extent relative to the part, 0..1. Patch and radiating only.

to.description: Line and radiating: where it goes

context.description: SOCRATES fields not covered by marks. All optional. Free text stays free text.

activity.description: What I was doing when it started

triggers.description: What makes it worse / brings it on

associated.description: What came with it (e.g. nausea, dizziness)

mind.description: Same timeline as the body. Optional on every record. Numbers only, no labels like 'severe'.

mood.description: 0 low .. 10 high. No valence words in UI.

visit.description: kind = visit. The doctor export uses the latest visit as the start of 'since last visit'.

department.description: Free text or an id from routing/departments.json

name.description: e.g. ECG, blood panel, MRI lumbar
